games.name: obby but you're a poop
games.desc:
💩🔥 Welcome to Obby But You're a Poop! 🔥💩

Facing challenges and overcoming obstacles is part of the game. However, don't let the difficulty overwhelm you! The primary objective of the game is to provide an enjoyable and entertaining experience. Take a moment to relax and concentrate on the current task. Remember to utilize your double jump ability to give yourself an extra advantage. In moments of frustration, remind yourself that it's just a game, and you can always take a break and return later.

Obby But You're a Potato is a must-play for any Roblox obby enthusiast. So why not give it a try? Leave a thumbs up if you enjoy it and find out if you possess the skills to conquer all 120 stages!

*Inspired by Obby but you're a potato*
